hero.title: Give everyone a voice.
hero.subtitle: TalkSign helps speech-impaired users communicate with friends in natural language using AI.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple, three-step process to seamless communication.

step1.title: 1. Record or Upload
step1.desc: Record or upload a short video or audio clip of what you want to communicate.

step2.title: 2. AI Interpretation
step2.desc: Our AI understands gestures and speech, converting them into clear text.

step3.title: 3. Communicate
step3.desc: Use the generated text to communicate clearly and effectively.

aiInterpretation.title: AI Video & Audio Interpretation
aiInterpretation.desc: State-of-the-art AI to translate visual and auditory cues into text.

realtime.title: Real-time Text Generation
realtime.desc: Convert your intent into clear, natural language instantly.

rephrasing.title: AI-Assisted Rephrasing
rephrasing.desc: Get intelligent suggestions to refine your message.

history.title: Temporary Session History
history.desc: Keep track of your generated messages during your session.

voiceText.title: Voice ↔ Text Conversion
voiceText.desc: Seamlessly convert text to speech and speech to text.

accessible.title: Accessible by Design
accessible.desc: High contrast, large controls, and simple flows for everyone.

accessibility.title: Accessibility and Privacy First
accessibility.subtitle: We are committed to building a platform that is not only powerful but also inclusive and secure for all our users.
accessibility.feature1: Large buttons, big icons, and simple workflows for ease of use.
accessibility.feature2: High contrast and readable fonts to ensure clarity for visually impaired users.
accessibility.feature3: Your privacy is respected. No data is stored without an account.

video.allowCamera: Allow the browser to use your webcam for preview.

speech.title: Auto-read responses
speech.note: Only reads new AI responses (left column). If you turn it off, the reading queue will be cleared immediately.
